objective: Characterize the isolated Film Damage global flicker gain across control strength and selected normal variates, measuring tone/HDR-range, sign inversion, hue response and alpha-edge compositing under straight and premultiplied storage assumptions.

scope.effect: FilmDamageCPUImpl per-pixel sourceRGB * flickerGain term only; grain, dust, scratches, gate weave and film burn are neutralized.
scope.method: Offline deterministic float32 equation model with fixed standard-normal z labels {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3}; these are diagnostic variates and do not reproduce std::normal_distribution or frame draws.
excluded: actual frame-to-frame flicker sequence or temporal perception

comparison.baseline: Same source fixture at gain=1 (flicker=0 or z=0); arithmetic response reference only, not a look target.
candidates: straight and correctly premultiplied representations of one translucent tone/color chart
comparison.ground_truth: No external ground truth. The paired gain=1 input isolates equation response, not acceptable exposure behavior.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive only; report gain sign/range, tone and region response. Do not infer event frequency from z labels or call a control value visually good/bad.

materials.fixture: Locally generated 512x256 synthetic alpha ellipse containing black/shadow/midtone/highlight and saturated RGB/CMY patches, near-white, high-contrast lines and a checker detail; RGB is zero outside alpha.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Record hashes for source, plan, runner, fixture, metrics and previews.

conditions.numeric_domain: Float32 BGRA storage; logical RGB direct numeric values in [0,1], no transfer conversion. Source RGB is multiplied by gain without output clamp; source alpha is copied unchanged.
conditions.alpha: For premultiplied branch, multiply fixture RGB by alpha before applying gain. Straight composite=storedRGB*alpha+background*(1-alpha); premultiplied composite=storedRGB+background*(1-alpha). Use black, numeric gray .18, white backgrounds.
conditions.controls: flicker={0,.08,.25,.5,1}; z={-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3}; all other Film Damage controls zero; seed=1977/evolution=0 are labels only since no RNG is executed.
metrics: computed gain and negative/zero/positive sign class
RGB min/max and below-zero/above-one/nonfinite channel rates
per patch and alpha-region RGB/composite delta MAE/RMSE/p95/max vs gain=1
conditions.display: Contact sheets label flicker and z, rendered over gray18 with common direct [0,1] clip; raw float metrics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify gain formula, exact RGB scaling, alpha passthrough, z=0 and flicker=0 identity, finite output, and selected sign-boundary cases.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: z=0 or flicker=0 gives identity within float tolerance; outputs otherwise match the fixed equation. No compiled parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect full chart/contact sheet and named tone/detail crops at 1:1; report negative-gain and range crossings without aesthetic judgment.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; fixed z values are response probes, not perceptual acceptance samples.

color_and_alpha.method: Measure correctly represented straight/premultiplied inputs and source-over composites over black/gray/white; alpha must be exact.
color_and_alpha.unverified: Actual layer descriptor, random z sequence, downstream clamp and product compositor response.

temporal_stability.reason: No sequence of actual random draws or rendered frames; this isolates per-sample response only.

render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Actual app route, preview/final size mapping, GPU parity and display transform.

performance.reason: No product timing or memory measurement.

execution.backend: Python 3 and NumPy; offline synthetic fixture only.
execution.threshold_policy: Descriptive only; no perceptual thresholds are invented.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed fixture, z grid and control grid; record package versions and source/plan/runner/fixture/preview hashes.
